categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies CNetAddr routing logic in src/netaddress.cpp to filter out multicast addresses, directly impacting addrman and outbound peer selection.
categories.rationale: Prevents Bitcoin Core from storing multicast addresses in addrman or dialing them for outbound connections. As noted in commit d54f486882, 'Gossiped multicast addresses were therefore accepted into addrman and could be selected for outbound connections,' which wastes outbound slots on unreachable targets; while useful address-management hygiene, it is reasonably deferrable.
